Description

Observe the space radiation environment from high Earth orbit (HEO).

K-RADCube is a satellite managed by the Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute (KASI). NaraSpace is responsible for comprehensive system support for the entire mission, including main body construction, space environment testing, launch preparation, and post-launch operations.
Notes

Classification is based on NASA signing contracts with local space agencies.
